summary: Approved. The live realistic flashlight path now applies ray-traced spotlight shadow intent only after hardware RT was requested and runtime CVar readback confirms true; unsupported or mismatched Vulkan SM5 readback skips the reflected RT shadow call safely. The user can rerun the same realistic live cafeteria command; on VULKAN_SM5 without confirmed hardware RT, expect hardware RT shadow intent to be skipped with log state/caveat while realistic non-RT Lumen lighting continues.
work_completed: Confirmed examples/flashlight/run.py gates ray-traced spotlight shadow intent through runtime readback: apply_live_spot_light_ray_traced_shadow_intent returns before calling intent_fn unless requested_by_config, cast_shadows, and runtime_confirmed are all true at lines 594-630.

Confirmed examples/flashlight/run.py collects hardware RT runtime command/readback state before flashlight setup at lines 749-752 and uses it for the live spotlight RT shadow intent call at lines 802-805.

Confirmed examples/flashlight/flashlight_profiles.py apply_spot_light_ray_traced_shadow_intent uses a bool_only strategy and sends only True through reflected method/property attempts at lines 338-399; no string/enum value candidates such as Enabled are sent by this helper.
Confirmed tests cover unsupported RT readback, false readback, confirmed readback, and bool-only method/property candidate behavior in tests/test_orbit_collection_validation.py.
Ran python -m unittest tests.test_orbit_collection_validation: 90 tests passed.
Ran python -m py_compile examples/flashlight/run.py examples/flashlight/flashlight_profiles.py tests/test_orbit_collection_validation.py successfully.

findings.message: No blocker found. Unsupported or unavailable hardware RT readback produces confirmed=None/False and apply_live_spot_light_ray_traced_shadow_intent skips with skipped_reason='hardware ray tracing runtime readback not confirmed' instead of touching reflected ray-traced shadow APIs.
On Linux VULKAN_SM5, hardware ray tracing may still be unsupported or ignored by the runtime; this repair makes that condition non-fatal rather than guaranteeing hardware RT will be active.

follow_up_recommendations: Rerun the user's realistic live cafeteria command. If VULKAN_SM5 does not confirm all requested RT CVars, expect logs to show unconfirmed hardware RT readback and skipped ray-traced shadow intent, not the previous crash.
memory_worthy: RT unsupported crash repair approved: realistic live flashlight only applies ray-traced spotlight shadow intent after confirmed hardware RT runtime readback; unsupported Vulkan SM5 skips safely.
